summary: Busy school-side kerb where cars park, but homes 13-14m on this side.
reasons: School and shops, lots of activity

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13m and 14m on this side; school and shops across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with cars in it; room for a van seems fine.
drivers.traffic: Busy local road near school, shops and a pool; lots of people.
drivers.convention: Cars and a caravan-type vehicle park on the street in the imagery.

flags: Passenger loading zone (2 min) schooldays 7:30-9:30am and 2-4pm
sun_shade: Open sky over the kerb; trees on the east side give some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: East kerb of Central Avenue by the school road bend, opposite the pool and shops
